messages:
mia_marketing: Quick creative ask for next week's launch: 3 social tiles + webinar hero + editable one-pager. Theme = inference economics (latency vs $/token). Need legal-friendly Dedicated footnote. Deadline: Tue EOD.

raj_design: OK. Will do 1080x1080 tiles, 1920x1080 hero, US Letter PDF. Prefer illustrations, single accent color. Which hex?

mia_marketing: Use #0067FF accent. Headline idea: 'Serve faster, spend smarter.' Keep copy punchy.

olen_copy: Microcopy for stat tile: 'Up to 3x lower token cost on cacheable flows.' CTA: 'Register for the benchmark webinar'

kate_growth: Add utm params: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_medium=social. Also request a 10s MP4 loop for LinkedIn.

raj_design: Will include Figma link, SVGs, PNGs, MP4 1080x1080 @30fps, and a layered PDF. Will add small footer: 'Dedicated: contractual SLAs and export controls available.'

assetbot: Reminder: upload to /assets/marketing/bench_launch/ by 2026-05-18T17:00:00Z for legal review.

mia_marketing: Thanks — ping here when first mock is uploaded.
